$comment: Machine-readable inventory for deveco-tool. Skill paths are relative to this repository; every directory under skills/ is copied from the official DevEco Code repository at the pinned upstream commit.
name: harmony-capability-pack

skills.name: arkts-error-fixes
skills.summary: ArkTS 编译错误和类型不匹配问题的分类修复参考。
skills.loadWhen: ArkTS 编译失败或需要修复类型错误时。

skills.name: arkts-grammar-standards
skills.summary: ArkTSLinter 规则、ArkTS 语法约束、ArkUI 结构约束和 TypeScript 迁移规则。
skills.loadWhen: 每个会话首次编写或修改 .ets 文件前。

skills.name: arkts-runtime-fix
skills.summary: ArkTS/JavaScript 运行时崩溃、faultlogger 和 Hilog 证据诊断。
skills.loadWhen: 应用闪退、崩溃、白屏或出现 JS crash 时。

skills.name: deveco-cli
skills.summary: DevEco CLI 的设备、模拟器、签名、UI、Skill 和兼容性检查命令参考。
skills.loadWhen: 管理 HarmonyOS 设备、模拟器、签名、Skill 或 UI 操作时。

skills.name: deveco-create-project
skills.summary: 使用官方脚本创建和初始化 ArkTS Stage 模型工程。
skills.loadWhen: 从零创建、初始化或搭建 ArkTS 工程时。

commands.name: spec-specify
commands.summary: Create or update the feature specification from a natural language description.

commands.name: spec-plan
commands.summary: Run the implementation planning workflow and produce design artifacts.

commands.name: spec-tasks
commands.summary: Generate an actionable, dependency-ordered tasks.md from the design artifacts.

commands.name: spec-implement
commands.summary: Execute every task in tasks.md up to and including the Polish phase.

commands.name: spec-verify
commands.summary: Build-only verification: build_project (max 10 attempts) then start_app, then report.

mcp.note: Requires Node >= 22 and `npm install` inside the pack root. Configure DEVECO_CLI_STUDIO_PATH for DevEco Studio or DEVECO_CLI_CLT_PATH for Command Line Tools.

toolGroups.note: Select project context, inspect the environment, or reset a stuck backend. CodeGenie project binding continues to use its upstream init_project_path internally.
arkts_knowledge_search requires a China-site Huawei DevEco login.

The current official ace-server advertises definition, references, hover and implementation. The dedicated aliases return readable 1-based positions; `lsp` exposes those four operations and preserves raw 0-based LSP response positions.

Read and drive the UI of a connected device. ui_flow applies one generic decision chain: exact manifest route, saved semantic flow, then automatic exploration recording. Safe selector healing persists only after the final assertion. verify_ui is a local final-verification tool whose captures stay in the OS temp directory; upstream save_ui_screenshot and get_ui_verification_log remain disabled. perform_ui_action resolves `hvd` from connected devices when omitted. get_app_ui_tree and perform_ui_action remain upstream CodeGenie proxies; ui_snapshot / ui_observe / ui_find / ui_tap / ui_flow / verify_ui run locally and survive a stalled child.
Manage emulator instances, images and licenses, and simulate device scenarios through the official DevEco CLI.

hostToolMapping.$comment: Tools the upstream commands assumed, which this pack does NOT provide. Map them onto your host's equivalents before running the SDD commands.
hostToolMapping.spec_write: Any file-write tool. Upstream used a dedicated spec artifact writer; the commands here just say 'the host's file-write tool'.
hostToolMapping.question: Your host's ask-the-user mechanism. spec-specify needs it for clarification gates.
hostToolMapping.task: Your host's subagent/delegation mechanism. Optional - the commands run fine single-threaded.
hostToolMapping.read/edit/write/glob/grep: Your host's own file and search tools.

invocationPolicy.$comment: Host adapters may add local invocation policy without modifying the official skill files.

disableImplicitInvocation.$comment: Only project creation is disabled for implicit invocation because it writes a new project tree.
disableImplicitInvocation.deveco-create-project: Creates directories and writes a project tree.

mcpDependency.$comment: Official skills whose instructions or bundled scripts use tools exposed by this MCP. Recomputed by tests from the skill contents.

excluded.$comment: Non-skill DevEco Code capabilities that are intentionally not copied into skills/.
excluded.agents: DevEco Code agent definitions and runtime permission harness are application internals, not built-in skills.
excluded.uiVerification: The CodeGenie model-based UI verification chain is not part of the official built-in skill directory and remains disabled in this MCP gateway.
